svg.title: Level geometry of Wang’s higher-dimensional convex translators
svg.desc: A teal closed elongated convex schematic level surface above an ochre exact round cylinder of radius square root of two. These are two-dimensional horizontal sections in the base R3 of a graph in R4, not the full translator. The finite shape uses a stated illustrative convex function. The cylinder represents the k equals two quadratic blow-down model, with both ends cut off for display.

g.text: A hypersurface in ℝ⁴, seen through its level surfaces
Circle symmetry in (x₁,x₂); axial dependence in x₃.
The free direction is x₃. Both cylinder ends are truncated.
Finite shape is illustrative; no translator PDE is solved.
